title: The Ridge
content: My mentor in Japan, Tanaka-san, and I hiked the same ridge trail most Sundays. One morning I cancelled on him, said next week. He went alone, slipped in the fog, and fell. I never got to say goodbye. That's where I learned that you don't always get a next week, and that resilience is bowing and rising, not bouncing back.
